# hivelocity_vps_network_attachment (Resource)

Attaches a VPS instance to a `hivelocity_vps_network`. The resource ID is `<device_id>:<network_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hivelocity_vps_network_attachment" "app_backend" {
  device_id  = hivelocity_vps.app.device_id
  network_id = hivelocity_vps_network.backend.network_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (Number) ID of the VPS instance.
- `network_id` (String) ID of the VPS network.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ip_address` (String) IPv4 address of the NIC, if any.
- `nic_id` (String) ID of the NIC created for the attachment.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String)
- `delete` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import with <device_id>:<network_id>
terraform import hivelocity_vps_network_attachment.app_backend 12345:net-abc123
```
